components_rich_editor_addprosemirrorplu: Tiptap/ProseMirror extension method that registers the ProseMirror plugins the extension needs into the editor.
components_rich_editor_al: A minified ProseMirror helper related to resolving document positions.
components_rich_editor_appendmap: ProseMirror transform Mapping method that appends a single step map to the mapping chain.
components_rich_editor_cellsinrect: prosemirror-tables helper that returns the positions of table cells within a given rectangular selection.
components_rich_editor_ch: A minified ProseMirror helper related to replacing or slicing document content.
components_rich_editor_checkcontent: ProseMirror schema helper that validates a node's content against its allowed content expression.
components_rich_editor_coordsatpos: ProseMirror EditorView method that returns the on-screen pixel coordinates for a document position.
components_rich_editor_createdoc: Tiptap Editor method that builds the initial ProseMirror document from the given content and schema.
components_rich_editor_deleterange: ProseMirror Transform method that deletes the document content within a given range.
components_rich_editor_domatpos: ProseMirror EditorView method that maps a document position to the corresponding DOM node and offset.
components_rich_editor_domselection: ProseMirror EditorView method that returns the browser's current native DOM selection.
components_rich_editor_done: A minified ProseMirror view helper used in mouse/pointer gesture handling (start/move/up/stop).
components_rich_editor_dragover: ProseMirror DOM event handler for dragover events that positions the drop cursor during drag-and-drop.
components_rich_editor_dx: A minified ProseMirror helper related to document fragments or slices.
components_rich_editor_dy: A minified ProseMirror helper related to resolved document positions, used alongside coordsAtPos.
components_rich_editor_eg: ProseMirror schema helper that checks content matches and finds wrapping node types for insertion.
components_rich_editor_em: A minified ProseMirror helper related to slice replacement.
components_rich_editor_extend: Tiptap Extension method used to create a customized copy of an extension with overridden options or configuration.
components_rich_editor_ey: A minified ProseMirror Fragment helper for accessing child nodes and slices.
components_rich_editor_fd: Minified name for ProseMirror's ResolvedPos-related helper, used to compute coordinates and depth boundaries of a position.
components_rich_editor_fo: A minified ProseMirror Fragment class helper providing child node lookup and traversal.
components_rich_editor_gg: A minified ProseMirror DOM node-view helper that updates attributes and splits DOM nodes.
components_rich_editor_go: A minified ProseMirror Fragment class helper providing iteration, joining, and splitting of fragments.
components_rich_editor_handleexit: ProseMirror/Tiptap keymap handler that exits a special node (such as a code block) by inserting text and clearing stored marks.
components_rich_editor_handlepaste: ProseMirror DOM event handler for paste events that parses clipboard HTML/text into document content.
components_rich_editor_hl: A minified ProseMirror helper that traverses nodes between two positions to find marks.
components_rich_editor_ho: A minified ProseMirror helper related to mark lookup across a node range.
components_rich_editor_ignoremutation: ProseMirror NodeView method that determines whether a given DOM mutation should be ignored by the editor view.
components_rich_editor_kr: A minified ProseMirror schema helper used alongside content-match and wrapping lookups.
components_rich_editor_kt: A minified ProseMirror Node helper that compares node markup for equality (same type, attrs, and marks).
components_rich_editor_l0: A minified ProseMirror helper that checks whether a mark type is allowed within a given mark set.
components_rich_editor_merge: ProseMirror transform helper that merges adjacent mapping steps when combining document changes.
components_rich_editor_mustmoveinline: ProseMirror content-fitting helper that determines whether a position must move to stay within inline content while replacing a range.
components_rich_editor_os: prosemirror-tables helper used alongside cellsInRect to update node markup for cells in a table selection.
components_rich_editor_parseslice: ProseMirror DOMParser method that parses a DOM subtree into a document Slice.
components_rich_editor_pm: A minified ProseMirror schema helper related to content group membership checks.
components_rich_editor_po: A minified ProseMirror Fragment helper used for finding and splitting content.
components_rich_editor_positionat: prosemirror-tables helper that computes a table-relative position for a given point.
components_rich_editor_pr: A minified ProseMirror helper that resolves positions and iterates marks across nodes between them.
components_rich_editor_pu: A minified ProseMirror NodeView helper used when selecting a node and updating internal editor state.
